title: Proof-of-concept scans of known structures
place_text: Gran Sasso Laboratory, Italy; Osiris Shaft, Egypt

tellings.quote: And this technology was very good at accurately detecting the known structures within these modern facilities that were scanned. But also the Osiris shaft, too.

plain: A scanning technology linked to the researcher Filippo Biondi correctly picked out known structures inside modern buildings, such as a laboratory in Italy called Gran Sasso, and also a deep shaft in Egypt known as the Osiris Shaft, according to a researcher named Jeffrey Drum. Drum tells Michels this as a test run, done in the 2020s, which showed the method works before it was used beneath the Egyptian pyramids. If the test holds, it would give weight to what the same scans later seemed to show under the pyramids.
